item.title: Remainder - Android Game
item.description:
We’re thrilled to introduce Remainder, our latest Android game designed to provide hours of fun and mental stimulation. Whether you’re a puzzle enthusiast or just looking for a quick game to pass the time, Remainder offers an addictive gameplay experience.

Game Features

  • Challenging puzzles that test your logic
  • Intuitive controls for seamless gameplay
  • Offline mode for playing anywhere
  • Regular updates with new levels

Download Remainder now from the Google Play Store and start your gaming adventure!

item.title: Modern Hindu Baby Names: Find the Perfect Name
item.description:
Modern Hindu Baby Names is a beautifully crafted Android application designed to help parents discover the perfect name for their newborn. The challenge: create a seamless, easy-to-use directory with rich meanings and offline support.

Intuitive and Elegant Design

Every aspect of the user interface was designed with simplicity and elegance in mind. Finding the right name should be a joyful experience, not a chore. The app offers a smooth, distraction-free environment for exploring thousands of names.

item.title: Chowk: Hyperlocal Networking for Creators
item.description:
Chowk is a scalable, mobile-ready Android app designed for digital creators to connect, network, and grow their community. Available now on the Google Play Store, Chowk brings hyperlocal discovery and real-time networking to your fingertips.

Hyperlocal Discovery

Chowk leverages map-based and GPS-powered technology to help users discover fellow creators nearby. Whether you’re looking to collaborate, share ideas, or simply connect, Chowk makes it easy to find and interact with creators in your vicinity.

item.title: Storoxo.com: Quick Commerce, Ultra Lean Stack
item.description:
Storoxo.com is a next-gen quick commerce site — live, fast, and built to scale. The challenge: deliver a full-stack experience (user signup, email, payments, admin, and more) for under ₹1000/month.

Byte-to-Byte Optimization

Every line of code was tuned for performance. No bloat, no waste — just pure, efficient delivery. We used non-volatile hosting, so the site stays up and fast, with zero downtime.

Full-Stack, Fully Integrated

  • Razorpay payments built-in
  • User signup & email notifications
  • Admin dashboard, order management, and more

The result? A quick commerce engine that’s affordable, robust, and ready for scale. Storoxo proves you don’t need a big budget for big impact.

item.title: Yognishtha Trust: A Zero-Cost, Seamless Deployment Journey
item.description:
At Plotkai Interactive, we take pride in building scalable and cost-efficient digital foundations for organizations doing meaningful work. One such collaboration was with Yognishtha Trust — a non-profit initiative focused on holistic wellbeing and community upliftment. Their goal was simple: to have a clean, fast, and sustainable website that communicated their mission effectively without recurring infrastructure costs.

Building for Simplicity and Impact

Instead of over-engineering the stack, we focused on efficiency. The site was designed with a minimal front-end, static content generation, and a fully automated CI/CD pipeline. Everything runs on Google Cloud’s free-tier infrastructure — meaning Yognishtha Trust pays zero ongoing cost for hosting or maintenance.

item.title: Hello from Plotkai Interactive – Why We Started
item.description:
Hello and welcome to Plotkai Interactive. We’re a creative digital agency based in Lucknow, India, specializing in web development, branding, and digital marketing. Our mission? To blend creativity with technology and build standout digital experiences that drive real business growth.

We started Plotkai because we believe that great ideas deserve more than just ‘good enough’ execution. Too many tools complicate what should be simple — turning ideas into digital experiences should be clear, empowering, and human-centred.

item.title: Building Digital Products with Purpose
item.description:
At Plotkai Interactive, we believe the web should empower creators, not overwhelm them. Too many tools complicate what should be simple — turning great ideas into digital experiences. We’re here to change that by helping startups, creators, and organizations build software that truly works for people.

  • We make technology accessible, human, and beautifully designed.
  • We help founders go from idea to product faster — with clarity, creativity, and code that scales.
  • We believe every great digital experience starts with purpose and empathy, not just pixels and APIs.

Small Team. Bold Vision. Global Impact.

We're a compact, fast-moving team based in India — with a global mindset and partners who help us build at scale. From custom-built web apps to intelligent cloud infrastructure, we deliver enterprise-grade performance with startup agility.
